flags.question: q3
flags.note: Levels blend different quantities (number of markers off, pain, and injury stopping training), so a record with one marker far off and no pain, or pain with normal markers, fits several levels for different reasons.

flags.question: q4
flags.note: Options differ along more than one axis (volume, rest, and exercise type), so a plan such as a few rest days with cross-training could fit more than one option.
